summary: Verified visual fix for 'ñ' rendering with Plane Crash font in /nosotros history milestones and login modal. The fix in renderPlaneCrash (designSystem.js) now renders 'n' in the inherited Plane Crash font (same grunge texture) with a small overlaid tilde (~) in Anton, rotated -4deg, positioned above. Tested TEST 1, TEST 2, TEST 3 (login modal), TEST 4 (flow regression). All pass.

test_results.TEST_1_ntilde_visual_nosotros: PASS - Clicked history-label-2019, overlay shows '¿COMO EMPEZO TODO, EN QUE AÑO?' with Ñ rendered in same grunge Plane Crash texture as surrounding letters plus small tilde above. No font mismatch anymore.
test_results.TEST_2_no_layout_overflow: PASS - overlay scrollWidth==clientWidth (1216px), hasOverflow=false. Question wraps correctly within max-w-xl.
test_results.TEST_3_ntilde_regression_login: PASS - Login modal 'INGRESA TU CONTRASEÑA' shows Ñ with same grunge texture + tilde. Detected 1 relative-position wrapper span containing 'n' + '~' as expected.
test_results.TEST_4_kow_flow_regression: PASS (implicit) - Welcome overlay dismissed on click, history labels rendered (7 found: intro/2019/2021/2022/2023/2025/2026), clicking label expands photo + shows year overlay with question. No JS/console errors related to the change (only unrelated 401s for background resources).

critical_code_review_comments: renderPlaneCrash implementation is clean and appropriate: uses whiteSpace:nowrap only on words containing 'ñ' (preserving wrapping for the rest), inherits color via currentColor, and uses aria-hidden on the tilde overlay for accessibility.
Minor: the tilde is rendered in Anton family which is a slight typographic mismatch, but visually acceptable and documented in the file's JSDoc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: renderPlaneCrash in /app/frontend/src/lib/designSystem.js is the shared helper for Plane Crash text with 'ñ'. When testing any UI text with 'ñ' rendered in Plane Crash, expect a nested n~. Fix verified in FSCHistorySection year overlay and LoginModal.
